newsitem.title: UK: Kingfisher down on BUT talks.
newsitem.headline: Kingfisher down on BUT talks.

text.p: Shares in British retailer Kingfisher Plc fell back on Thursday after the company said it would hold talks on the possibility of increasing its stake in French electrical equipment retailer BUT.
Kingfisher, which already owns 26 percent of BUT, said it had authorised discussions with the Venturini family, who own just over 30 percent of the company.
The retailer said it would pay no more than 300 francs per share.
A spokesman for Kingfisher said the company had made the statement at the request of the French bourse after speculation in French newspapers that the company intended to increase its stake.
UK retail analysts calculated it could cost Kingfisher between 210 to 250 million stg to buy the Venturini stake, but they doubted it would opt for a rights issue.
The shares closed 15 pence lower at 701.5 pence.
